workLog.summary: Reproduced the conftest collision issue 3371 reported, then proved --import-mode=importlib does not fix it: pytest derives the module name from the __init__.py chain, and consider_namespace_packages cannot disambiguate because .claude is not a legal Python identifier.

Wrote the converse assertion and it detonated. The defect is 41 times larger than filed: 82 skill-bundle test directories, 118 files, 2052 test functions never collected, against 13969 collected. Issue 3371 named 2 of the 82.
Found the collision is cross-tree only. Skill names are unique within a tree, so one subprocess per tree collects everything: .claude in 10.15s, src/copilot-cli in 10.15s. Six tests were failing.

Fixed a real side-effect bug: _artifact_dir in the retrospective evidence reader promised in its docstring not to create the directory, then called resolve_artifact_root, which mkdirs. Split resolution from creation in paths.py so one place computes the path.

Repaired a stale classifier test that fed an absolute tmp_path to a repo-root-anchored segment matcher, and deleted a pre-ADR-080 fork of the requirements-interview contract test whose canonical copy under tests/ already passes.

Added tests/test_skill_bundle_suites_run.py: one subprocess per tree root plus the converse guard that fails when a bundle suite sits outside the configured roots. Scans tracked git paths so local worktrees are not mistaken for shipped bundles.

Five negative controls, all confirmed red: reverting the non-creating resolver, making artifact_dir mkdir again, removing the chdir from the classifier test, dropping a tree root from the guard, and reintroducing a bundle failure.
